markdownRemark.html:
Context: Anxiety is stoked regarding rising fuel prices, and inflation, following, reports of hostilities in the Persian gulf, and perfidious statements by Western officials.

Scribed word drives back those of the East,
Athena brings them to their knees,
Screen pixels distort what we see,
As vessels ship black blood we need,
Spectors of strength in flux and flow,
The universal wolf's thirst grows,
Theatric horrors put on show,
Kabbalic kooks claim the end's known,

The Fuel of Great Profit Seas,

A global formed Babel tower,
As man's farmed to feed its power,
With revelation over tones,
The old aeon is staged to go,
Actors in suits stage rolled out troops,
Normalising cleansing roots,
Spilling blood of Gog and Magog,
The Normans win against all odds,

The Fools fall for Prophesies,

Only true Israelites can see,
The word will shape what comes to be,
Just scripts serving the sovereign's needs,
From which most will never break free,
Men will become what they believe,
The earth is shaped by what men need,
Myth that acts as our action's seeds,
Entrancing words make history.
